instruction: Could you assist me in turning off the dark mode feature in Google Chrome? I've noticed that while dark mode is great for reducing glare, it actually makes it more challenging for me to read text clearly, especially with my astigmatism.

action:
import pyautogui
import time
# Click on the address bar
pyautogui.click(400, 89)
time.sleep(0.5)
# Type the Chrome flags URL for dark mode setting
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://flags/#enable-force-dark', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1)
response:
Looking at the screenshot, Google Chrome is open with a New Tab page. There are some notification popups, but they shouldn't block the address bar. To turn off dark mode in Chrome, I'll first check the Chrome flags for the force dark mode setting, which is the common way dark mode is enabled for web contents.

```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Click on the address bar
pyautogui.click(400, 89)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Type the Chrome flags URL for dark mode setting
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://flags/#enable-force-dark', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1)
```
